title: I purchased three of these at TJX; they are super thin and tear easily; holds a lot
text:
I purchased three of these at TJX; they are super thin and tear easily; holds a lot. I purchased three (3) of these bags at TJX for $4.99 each plus tax (one in espresso color, another in grey, and one in dusty blue). They each are 24 in long x 18 in front to back x 12 in high.

The zipper extends around on both sides and there is a peek-a-boo window in front. There is also a handle on each side but I recommend it not be used.

The one I attached a picture of is in the espresso color. They hold a lot and because of that are heavy when moved. I was able to store one full shelf of shirts from my armoire in this one bag (about 40 tee shirts).

The problem with this bag is that it is made of a thin material that is like those free shopping bags supermarkets sell or different companies give out. Mine ripped immediately. It is just good for storage in place (without moving it).

Since I only paid $4.99 plus tax for each one, I feel it is okay for one time use as long as I gingerly carry it to its storage location or pack it at its exact storage location. However, this might rip the first moment used (as mine did by the handle). I would never pay $14.99 for this bag since it almost feels like tissue paper. I prefer thick plastic storage bags instead.
